newsitem.title: USA: Fountain Powerboat stake cut by Triglova.
newsitem.headline: Fountain Powerboat stake cut by Triglova.

text.p: Triglova Finanz A.G., a Panama-based investment company, said Wednesday it cut its stake in Fountain Powerboat Industries Inc to 6.7 percent or 209,500 common shares of the company's 3,129,072 shares outstanding.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Triglova said it sold 66,200 shares of the company between Dec. 10 and Jan. 9 at prices ranging from $17 to $18.625 per share.
It said it holds the stake for investment purposes.
The company, based in Washington, N.C., designs and manufactures deep water sports and sport-fishing boats.
